name: Lithography Stepper (ASML-type)
description: Photolithography stepper/scanner — exposure energy, overlay accuracy, lens temperature, wafer throughput

operations.name: read_exposure_energy
operations.desc: Read exposure dose energy (target: 30.0 mJ/cm², tolerance ± 0.5)
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov al, 0x00
out 0x43, al
in al, 0x40
movzx eax, al
in al, 0x40
movzx ecx, al
shl ecx, 8
or eax, ecx
xor edx, edx
mov ecx, 6553
div ecx
add eax, 2950
ret
operations.returns: Exposure energy * 100 in EAX (e.g., 3000 = 30.00 mJ/cm², range 2950-3050)

operations.name: read_overlay_accuracy
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov al, 0x00
out 0x43, al
in al, 0x40
movzx eax, al
in al, 0x40
movzx ecx, al
shl ecx, 8
or eax, ecx
xor edx, edx
mov ecx, 10922
div ecx
add eax, 10
ret
operations.returns: Overlay in 0.1nm units (e.g., 25 = 2.5nm, range 10-60, alert if > 30)

operations.name: read_light_source_hours
operations.desc: Read excimer laser source hours (replace at 20 billion pulses / ~5000 hours)
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov al, 0x00
out 0x43, al
in al, 0x40
movzx eax, al
in al, 0x40
movzx ecx, al
shl ecx, 8
or eax, ecx
xor edx, edx

div ecx
add eax, 3200
ret
operations.returns: Hours in EAX (range 3200-8200, warn if > 4500, replace at 5000)
